name: Ramsay Health Care
h1: Transformation across the network, delivered faster
lede: Ramsay's Group-wide transformation is focused on improved execution and faster delivery of strategic and operational initiatives across its Australian hospital network. Airtable gives those initiatives one connected place to run.
why_h2: Transformation, capital projects and a demerger at once
why_p: Ramsay is lifting performance, opening theatres and separating Ramsay Santé in the same year, and each runs across Property, Clinical and Finance teams.

signals.title: Transformation under strengthened leadership
signals.body: 1H FY26 group revenue was A$9.38 billion, up 9.3 percent, with a strengthened Group leadership team tasked with faster delivery of strategic and operational initiatives and a new Research and Development Network across 21 sites.
signals.angle: Replace fragmented trackers with one portfolio view of transformation initiatives, owners and status.
signals.src: Ramsay Health Care 1H FY26 results, 26 Feb 2026

signals.title: FY26 results: momentum and new theatres
signals.body: Ramsay reported FY26 group underlying NPAT up 23 percent in constant currency, with all regions growing EBIT and 22 new theatres opened as theatre utilisation rose to 70 percent.
signals.angle: Run capital projects and theatre openings as connected programmes across Property, Clinical and Finance.
signals.src: Ramsay Health Care ASX announcement, 27 Aug 2026

signals.title: Ramsay Santé demerger moves to a vote
signals.body: After first announcing the plan in February, Ramsay confirmed the demerger of its 52.79 percent stake in Ramsay Santé, with shareholder meetings on 24 November 2026 and completion expected in December 2026.
signals.angle: Keep separation workstreams, dependencies and sign-offs visible in one programme base.
signals.src: Ramsay Health Care ASX announcement, 16 Oct 2026
